newsitem.title: USA: USDA raises FY 1997 U.S. ag export forecast.
newsitem.headline: USDA raises FY 1997 U.S. ag export forecast.

text.p: U.S. agricultural exports are forecast to total $56.5 billion in fiscal year 1997, up $1.0 billion from December projections, Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said Monday.
In a speech to launch USDA's annual Agricultural Outlook Forum, Glickman said the upward revision was due to recent heavy shipments of oilseeds and cotton to China, the European Union and Mexico.

"It's still $3.5 billion below last year's record levels, but that's more the result of grain prices coming back down to earth than anything else," he said in the speech. "Our sheer volume of exports is still strong."
U.S. agricultural exports in fiscal 1996 hit a record $59.8 billion.
